metadata.name: IndicLearn Grounded RAG Evaluation Benchmark
metadata.description: Controlled benchmark for evaluating RAG retrieval quality, multi-chunk synthesis, citation accuracy, and insufficient evidence detection across English, Telugu script, Romanized Telugu, and code-mixed queries.

queries.query: What is an LTI system and what two core properties must it satisfy?
expected_key_points: Linear Time-Invariant system
Linearity (superposition and homogeneity)
Time-invariance (input time shift produces identical output time shift)

queries.query: What is the Nyquist rate and the condition for distortionless signal reconstruction?
expected_key_points: Sampling frequency fs >= 2 * B
Nyquist rate is exactly 2 * B
Bandlimited signal with maximum frequency B

queries.query: Define an energy signal versus a power signal in terms of energy and power values.
expected_key_points: Energy signal: finite total energy E and zero average power P = 0
Power signal: infinite total energy and finite non-zero average power
Periodic signals are power signals, transient pulses are energy signals

queries.query: What is the condition for BIBO stability of a discrete-time LTI system in the Z-plane?
expected_key_points: Z-transform maps discrete sequences into complex z-plane
ROC is a ring centered at origin
BIBO stable if and only if ROC contains the unit circle |z| = 1

queries.query: Explain continuous-time convolution and how it determines system output.
expected_key_points: Convolution integral combines input x(t) and impulse response h(t)
y(t) = integral x(tau) h(t - tau) dtau
Satisfies commutative, associative, and distributive properties

queries.query: What is the Continuous-Time Fourier Transform and what information does it provide?
expected_key_points: Represents continuous signal in frequency domain
Decomposes signal into complex sinusoidal components
Provides magnitude spectrum and phase spectrum

queries.query: Explain what the Region of Convergence is in the Laplace domain and its properties.
expected_key_points: Set of values s = sigma + j omega where integral converges
ROC cannot contain any poles
Bounded by vertical lines in complex plane
Determines system stability and causality

queries.query: What is aliasing and what kind of filter is used to prevent it?
expected_key_points: High frequency components fold over into lower frequencies when sampled below Nyquist rate
Prevented by an anti-aliasing low-pass filter before sampling
Attenuates frequencies exceeding fs / 2

queries.query: How is convolution computed in the time domain, and how does the Fourier Transform convolution property simplify its analysis in the frequency domain?
expected_key_points: Time domain requires convolution integral y(t) = integral x(tau) h(t - tau) dtau
Fourier transform convolution property converts time convolution to point-wise frequency multiplication: F{x(t)*h(t)} = X(omega) H(omega)
Enormously simplifies linear system response calculation

queries.query: Explain how an LTI system is characterized by its impulse response, and why convolution with this impulse response determines the output for any arbitrary input.
expected_key_points: LTI system satisfies linearity (superposition) and time-invariance
Completely characterized by unit impulse response h(t)
Convolution integral combines input with h(t) to yield output y(t)

queries.query: How does undersampling lead to aliasing distortion, and how do sampling theorem criteria combined with anti-aliasing and reconstruction filters ensure complete recovery?
expected_key_points: Nyquist theorem requires fs >= 2*B
Undersampling fs < 2*B causes high frequency folding (aliasing)
Anti-aliasing low-pass filter eliminates frequencies > fs/2 before sampling
Ideal low-pass interpolation filter reconstructs continuous signal

queries.query: How is Laplace transform convergence governed by the Region of Convergence, and how does the ROC determine whether a continuous-time LTI system is BIBO stable?
expected_key_points: ROC is complex plane region s = sigma + j omega where integral converges and contains no poles
BIBO stable if and only if ROC contains imaginary j omega axis
For causal stable system, poles must lie in open left-half plane Re(s) < 0

queries.query: కన్వల్యూషన్ అంటే ఏమిటి మరియు LTI సిస్టమ్ అవుట్‌పుట్‌ను నిర్ణయించడంలో దీని ప్రాముఖ్యత ఏమిటి?
expected_key_points: కన్వల్యూషన్ అనేది LTI సిస్టమ్ అవుట్‌పుట్‌ను నిర్ణయించే గణిత ప్రక్రియ
ఇన్పుట్ సిగ్నల్ x(t) మరియు ఇంపల్స్ రెస్పాన్స్ h(t) ల ఇంటిగ్రల్
commutative, associative మరియు distributive ధర్మాలను పాటిస్తుంది

queries.query: నైక్విస్ట్ శాంప్లింగ్ సిద్ధాంతం ప్రకారం సిగ్నల్‌ను పునర్నిర్మించడానికి కనీస ఫ్రీక్వెన్సీ ఎంత ఉండాలి?
expected_key_points: శాంప్లింగ్ ఫ్రీక్వెన్సీ fs >= 2 * B ఉండాలి
కనీస రేటును నైక్విస్ట్ రేట్ (2*B) అంటారు
బ్యాండ్‌లిమిటెడ్ సిగ్నల్‌ను విరూపణ లేకుండా పునర్నిర్మించవచ్చు

queries.query: ఎనర్జీ సిగ్నల్ మరియు పవర్ సిగ్నల్ మధ్య ముఖ్యమైన తేడాలు ఏమిటి?
expected_key_points: ఎనర్జీ సిగ్నల్: పరిమిత శక్తి (finite energy), సగటు పవర్ P = 0
పవర్ సిగ్నల్: అనంత శక్తి (infinite energy), పరిమిత సగటు పవర్
పీరియాడిక్ సిగ్నల్స్ పవర్ సిగ్నల్స్, ట్రాన్సియెంట్ పల్సులు ఎనర్జీ సిగ్నల్స్

queries.query: convolution ante enti mariyu h(t) impulse response tho output ela vasthundi?
expected_key_points: Convolution mathematical integral operation
x(t) mariyu h(t) convolution dwara y(t) output compute chestharu
LTI systems lo continuous-time response ni characterize chesthundi

queries.query: sampling theorem lo aliasing enduku avuthundi mariyu daanni ela prevent cheyali?
expected_key_points: fs < 2*B rate lo sample chesthe aliasing distortion avtundi
High frequencies low frequency loki fold avthayi
Anti-aliasing low-pass filter use chesi prevent cheyali

queries.query: Laplace transform lo ROC ante enti mariyu poles gurinchi em chepparu?
expected_key_points: Region of Convergence s-plane lo integral converge ayye region
ROC lo poles undavu (cannot contain any poles)
Stability mariyu causality ni determine chesthundi

queries.query: LTI system properties ni simple ga explain cheyyi and impulse response importance enti?
expected_key_points: Linearity (superposition and homogeneity)
Time-invariance (input shift equals output shift)
Unit impulse response h(t) completely characterizes the system

queries.query: Fourier transform convolution property frequency domain lo calculation ni ela simplify chesthundi explain cheyandi
expected_key_points: Time domain convolution becomes point-wise multiplication in frequency domain
F{x(t)*h(t)} = X(omega) H(omega)
System analysis enormously simplify avtundi

queries.query: BIBO stability conditions for continuous LTI systems Laplace transform lo describe cheyyandi
expected_key_points: Bounded-Input Bounded-Output stability
ROC must include imaginary j omega axis
For causal system, all poles must lie in open left-half of complex plane Re(s) < 0

queries.query: Explain the architecture of an FIR digital filter designed using Kaiser windowing techniques.
expected_key_points: Insufficient evidence
Kaiser window design for FIR filters is not contained in the provided course notes

queries.query: State space representation lo Kalman filtering algorithm tho state estimation ela calculate chestharu?
expected_key_points: Insufficient information
Kalman filter state estimation algorithm is not present in the uploaded material

queries.query: JPEG ఇమేజ్ కంప్రెషన్‌లో డిస్క్రీట్ కొసైన్ ట్రాన్స్‌ఫార్మ్ (DCT) ను ఎలా ఉపయోగిస్తారు?
expected_key_points: అందించిన మెటీరియల్‌లో సమాచారం లేదు
DCT మరియు JPEG కంప్రెషన్ పాఠ్యాంశాలలో అందుబాటులో లేవు
